is: the furnace knight — the ARMORED boarder, the 180-hp wall
source: THE OWNER'S OWN MODEL, 2026-08-02 (board SG-85) — not generated by tools/meshy.py, so there is no prompt, no task id and no credit line to record here. He built the Emberforge Sentinel and ran its OBJ export through Mixamo's auto-rigger, delivering a rigged character FBX plus 51 animation-only clips on that rig: the SG-74 Boilerwright shape exactly.

supersedes.what: The July generation by this pipeline — the FINAL Meshy reject, two attempts, filed to handoff-3d/README.md. Neither read as a wall of armor, and neither was ever wired: there was no armored.tscn, so the renderer drew the painted sprite.
supersedes.retired: armored.glb (3,500 tris) and armored_thumb.png left this folder when the owner's model landed. git log on this directory is where they live now.
supersedes.prompt: A huge armoured steampunk furnace knight: heavy riveted plate armour over a barrel chest with a glowing orange furnace grate in it; a domed helmet with a slotted visor and a spike on top; a brass chimney stack rising from the right shoulder; a pressure gauge on the left pauldron; a big double-bladed axe held across the body. One character alone, standing upright, facing forward, feet flat on the ground, arms clear of the body. No base, no plinth, no ground plane, no scenery, no duplicate, no text. Stylised game-ready steampunk airship character: blackened steel, riveted brass fittings, oxblood leather, oxidised copper accents, honest wear at the edges. Chunky readable forms and broad flat colour areas, not photoreal, no micro-detail. Flat albedo, no baked lighting, no baked shadow.
supersedes.texture_prompt: Blackened steel plate with warm brass trim and rivets, a hot orange furnace grate, oxblood leather straps, verdigris on the chimney, bare worn steel on the axe heads. Hand-painted stylised game texture: blackened gunmetal, warm polished brass, deep oxblood leather, dull oxidised-copper patina settled in the recesses, bare worn metal along the working edges. Any furnace, grate, vent, ember or lamp flame is hot orange; nothing else emits light. Broad flat colour areas, no baked lighting, no baked shadow, no text, no logos.

Meshy_AI_Emberforge_Sentinel_0802150810_texture_obj.zip — the OBJ that went through the auto-rigger
ingested_by: python tools/ingest_model.py armored — tools/models.json carries the whole recipe
screen_units_from: view3d.boarder_height("ARMORED") = (120 + radius*3) with no FIGURE_SCALE row — the renderer's own arithmetic. A head over the captain's 176, which is the point of him.
tris_note: Under the 4,000 law as delivered — the owner exported the REMESHED mesh this time, which is the zero-credit ask SG-74 left open on the Boilerwright's 12,476.
clip_rest_offset_note: One consistent offset across all 51 clips, so one retarget covered the lot (DESIGN.md 13l's Mixamo case).

emission.why: The furnace grille in his chest is his identity — handoff-3d asked for one emitter, hot orange, nothing else — so tools/ingest_model.gd learned to read an emission map for him, the first in this pipeline. The sheet is authored dim (peak 49/255, 0.03 in linear light), hence the energy. At 6 the lit area is 5.75% of his silhouette against the painted sprite's 6.48%, in the same orange; at 20 it is 5.90% (the tonemapper is saturated), so more buys nothing.
